answer: Every new agent pays a sybil tax of 40 POA, burned on entry, before trading. A beacon publishes each receipt and an audit list; each identity must answer a heartbeat at its vertex within 10 epochs or lose its slot. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, nothing recoverable, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps trading. A nebula of fakes collapses: each fake vertex still owes its tax, scale multiplies cost, never dilutes it.
